thread:
marco: Hey finance team 123 - heads up: Acme Bank (regulated customer, air-gapped private deployment) requested a one-off onboarding credit. Deal: 12-month Dedicated commit (~$420k ARR) + 24/7 managed support. Sales is asking for $25k credit applied to the first invoice to offset extra on-prem setup and SRE time. Can we get approval?

aisha: Need details before sign-off. Is this a discount, or are we moving cost into a PS line? Share commit docs and estimated engineering hours.

marco: Shared Deal Desk link with PS scope. Estimate: ~320 hours engineering/SRE/field work (~$40k internal cost). Customer will pay ~$15k as PS; remaining $25k they'd like covered via credit.

lina: Note from CS: this requires dedicated SRE rotations + extra audit support (SOC2/networking evidence). We'll need to account for 2 dedicated rotation weeks for the first 60 days.

amy_revops: RevOps checklist: 1) Confirm exact SKU the credit posts against; 2) Document as "one-time onboarding credit" in Deal Desk; 3) Add 90-day churn clawback clause; 4) Ensure credit ledger entry and GL code.

priya: Legal asks for a short addendum referencing the credit amount, PS scope/timeline, and clawback terms. I can draft but need final PS scope & timeline from Marco.

marco: Timeline in Deal Desk: 8 weeks to full handoff. I'll get eng to confirm hours.

aisha: Finance position: ok to approve up to $20k one-time credit (cap exposure) contingent on RevOps entry, Legal addendum with 90-day clawback, and CS signoff on rotations. If they insist on $25k escalate to me + Tom (CFO).

marco: Customer wants kickoff next Monday. Can we get the conditional approvals by EOD?

lina: I can sign off on rotations/schedule and confirm CS staffing. :white_check_mark:

amy_revops: I'll update Deal Desk and prepare the ledger entry. Will hold locking the SKU until Legal confirms wording.

priya: Drafting addendum now; estimate 2-3 business days for internal review. If they need to start earlier we can use a temporary SOW for PS work and mark credit as provisional pending executed addendum.

marco: Ok marking as "approved - conditional" pending those items. I'll notify the customer about conditional kickoff.

aisha: Conditional approval: approve up to $20,000 one-time onboarding credit, applied to first invoice, subject to RevOps ledger entry, Legal addendum with 90-day clawback, and CS signoff. If any condition isn't met escalate to me and @tom_cfo.

marco: Thanks all, adding action items in Deal Desk and tagging Priya/Amy/Lina.

deploy-bot: KICKOFF NOTE: provisional kickoff scheduled 2026-04-06 pending final paperwork.
